stayType: Working farm with self-catering cottages and lodges
accommodation: Eight cottages and lodges: Pinetree Lodge (sleeps 8), Granary Cottage (6), Birchtree and Larchtree Lodges (5 each), Fuchsia, Hydrangea and Firtree (4 each), Stable Cottage (3 plus cot); up to 40 when combined. A camping page exists but gives no details.
beachAccess: Site says Woolacombe is a short drive and Lee Bay a walk away; no distances given.
confirmedFeatures: Games room, outdoor play area, function room (The Old Dairy), farm shop, tractor and trailer rides, animal feeding, Shetland ponies
overview: A family farm at Lee, near Ilfracombe, with eight self-catering cottages and lodges that can be booked together for large groups. Children can join daily animal feeding, and there is a games room, play area and farm shop. Lee Bay is within walking distance and Woolacombe a short drive.
surfTripFit: Works for family or group surf trips to Woolacombe, a short drive away; Saunton is further south. No board storage or showers are mentioned.
gaps: Located at Lee/Ilfracombe, not Saunton - consider moving to a Woolacombe area page. Batch type said camping; mainly cottages. Parking and Wi-Fi not stated.
